assumptions: The schema is read and validated before the env file is read, so when both are bad the schema error is the one reported (UC-03 Steps order 2 before 3).
A repeated --schema flag is a usage error with reason 'expected exactly one --schema' (spec says exactly one; parseArgs alone would silently take the last).

Usage-error reasons from parseArgs (unknown flag, --schema without a value) are passed through verbatim after 'envlint: '; the spec fixes only 'missing --schema' and 'expected exactly one env file', which are used verbatim.
Read errors print err.code (ENOENT/EISDIR/EACCES/...) and fall back to err.message only if no code exists.
Exit code is set via process.exitCode rather than process.exit() so stdout flushes fully when piped.
